acacian-schism-onset.alt: Map of Europe around AD 476, showing the eastern empire and post-Roman West.
acacian-schism-onset.caption: Europe around the time Rome and Constantinople first broke communion over the Henotikon.

condemnation-of-arius.caption: Arius, whose teaching was condemned at Nicaea.

condemnation-of-eutyches.alt: Illustration of the Council of Chalcedon.
condemnation-of-eutyches.caption: Chalcedon drew the line against both division and confusion in Christ.

condemnation-of-nestorius.alt: Icon of the Third Ecumenical Council at Ephesus.
condemnation-of-nestorius.caption: The Council of Ephesus deposed Nestorius and affirmed Theotokos.

condemnation-of-origen.caption: Origen remained foundational for exegesis even as Origenist speculations were later condemned.

condemnation-of-pelagius.caption: Pelagius became the name attached to the Western dispute over grace and the first movement of faith.

council-of-carthage-397.alt: Early Christian basilica ruins at Carthage.
council-of-carthage-397.caption: Christian Carthage, the North African setting where bishops named the received biblical books.

council-of-chalcedon.alt: Illustration of the Council of Chalcedon.
council-of-chalcedon.caption: Chalcedon became the classic boundary for confessing Christ as one person in two natures.

council-of-constantinople-i.alt: Manuscript miniature of the First Council of Constantinople.
council-of-constantinople-i.caption: Constantinople I gave the church the creed most Christians now call Nicene.
council-of-constantinople-i.credit: Bibliotheque nationale de France, via Wikimedia Commons

council-of-constantinople-ii.alt: Icon of the Fifth Ecumenical Council.
council-of-constantinople-ii.caption: Constantinople II tried to defend Chalcedon while answering anti-Nestorian objections.

council-of-constantinople-iii.alt: Miniature from the Manasses Chronicle depicting an imperial council.
council-of-constantinople-iii.caption: The sixth council vindicated the claim that Christ has both a divine and human will.

council-of-ephesus.alt: Mosaic detail depicting the Council of Ephesus.
council-of-ephesus.caption: Ephesus made the unity of Christ the test beneath the Theotokos dispute.

council-of-jerusalem.caption: James the Just stands at the centre of Acts 15, where Gentile admission was judged in Jerusalem.

council-of-nicaea-i.alt: Icon of the First Council of Nicaea.
council-of-nicaea-i.caption: Nicaea made homoousios the decisive word in the Arian controversy.

council-of-nicaea-ii.alt: Miniature from the Menologion of Basil depicting the restoration of icons.
council-of-nicaea-ii.caption: Nicaea II defended holy images on incarnational grounds.

council-of-orange.alt: Roman Theatre of Orange in southern France.
council-of-orange.caption: Ancient Orange, the city where Western bishops clarified grace after Augustine.

council-of-toledo-iii.alt: Painting of King Reccared's conversion at the Third Council of Toledo.
council-of-toledo-iii.caption: Reccared's conversion brought Visigothic Spain out of Arianism and into Catholic communion.
council-of-toledo-iii.credit: Antonio Munoz Degrain, via Wikimedia Commons

death-of-john-of-damascus.alt: Cave of Saint John of Damascus at Mar Saba.
death-of-john-of-damascus.caption: Mar Saba, the monastic setting associated with John of Damascus and the close of the patristic age.

donatist-schism.alt: Painting of Augustine disputing with Donatists.
donatist-schism.caption: Augustine's long conflict with the Donatists shaped Western teaching on church unity and sacraments.
donatist-schism.credit: Charles Andre van Loo, via Wikimedia Commons

edict-of-milan.alt: Monument to Constantine the Great in Nis.
edict-of-milan.caption: Constantine's toleration settlement ended Christianity's illegal status and opened the council age.

fall-of-rome.alt: Manuscript illumination of sacred vessels carried to safety during Alaric's sack of Rome.
fall-of-rome.caption: The sack of Rome forced Christians to ask what hope means when the earthly city falls.

iconoclasm-onset.alt: Chludov Psalter miniature comparing iconoclasts to those who mocked Christ.
iconoclasm-onset.caption: The Chludov Psalter gives the icon debate a sharp visual argument.

novatian-schism.alt: Title page of The Treatise of Novatian on the Trinity.
novatian-schism.caption: Novatian's rigorist split began as a dispute over whether the lapsed could return.

synod-of-whitby.alt: William Henry Margetson painting of the Council of Whitby.
synod-of-whitby.caption: Whitby chose Roman practice for Northumbria's calendar and visible communion.
synod-of-whitby.credit: William Henry Margetson, via Wikimedia Commons

three-chapters-controversy.alt: Mosaic of Justinian I in San Vitale, Ravenna.
three-chapters-controversy.caption: Justinian's imperial theology project drove the Three Chapters controversy.
